primitives.name: Sport Equipment Choice Habits
primitives.verbatim_quote: Sporting and sports equipment choice habits of the students from Szombathely.
primitives.assumptions: Students' choices are influenced by accessibility, cost, peer influence, and perceived utility.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Habitual patterns break down under extreme price changes or new technological adoption.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian updating of latent preference states based on observable purchase data.
layer2.telemetry: Purchase frequency time series and price elasticity of demand.

primitives.name: Sport Career Influencing Factors
primitives.verbatim_quote: Factors influencing the sport careers of Hungarian elite volleyball players.
primitives.assumptions: Career progression depends on talent identification, training infrastructure, and socio-economic background.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Elite pathways collapse when institutional support fails or injury occurs.

layer2.mapping: Conformal prediction intervals for career transition probabilities given covariates.
layer2.telemetry: Longitudinal athlete tracking data and institutional funding metrics.

primitives.name: Motor Performance and Anxiety Comparison
primitives.verbatim_quote: Comparison of motor performance and social anxiety (SASC) of 10-12-year-old PE class and music class school children.
primitives.assumptions: Social anxiety mediates the relationship between physical activity and motor skill development.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Anxiety thresholds cause performance regression when exceeded.

layer2.mapping: State-space models tracking anxiety-induced state transitions in motor tasks.
layer2.telemetry: Heart rate variability and standardized anxiety scale scores.
